proof_body:
by
  intro V _ _ a b ha hb
  rw [LinearIndependent.pair_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h k hk
    have h0 : k • a + (-1 : ℝ) • b = 0 := by rw [hk]; module
    have := (h k (-1) h0).2
    norm_num at this
  · intro h s t hst
    by_cases ht : t = 0
    · subst ht
      have hs : s • a = 0 := by simpa using hst
      exact ⟨(smul_eq_zero.mp hs).resolve_right ha, rfl⟩
    · exfalso
      apply h (-(s / t))
      have : t • b = (-s) • a := by linear_combination (norm := module) hst
      calc b = t⁻¹ • (t • b) := by rw [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ ht, one_smul]
        _ = -(s / t) • a := by rw [this, smul_smul]; congr 1; field_simp
target_source: ∀ (V : Type*) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V] (a b : V), a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → (LinearIndependent ℝ ![a, b] ↔ ∀ k : ℝ, b ≠ k • a)
